scope: OWNED PUBLIC REPOSITORY RECORDS ONLY. This is a set of record identities across different granularities, NOT a deduplicated count of unique prayers in all sources.
method: Read public main canonical-data and explicit V3 source certification/novena review, public v4 and ICKSP hymn/novena/B01/B05 source modules. No inferred texts, original edition certification, online full-site scrape, commercial score permission or cross-identity merges.

nonconflation.short_name: Golden Arrow vs Sacred Heart Act
nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: ICKSP Golden Arrow is a Holy Face/Holy Name reparation, not Pius XI Iesu dulcissime.
nonconflation.owners: Batch 5 Sacred Heart content identity; Batch 2 Adoration links; Batch 1 #1800 staged registry.

nonconflation.short_name: Christ the King Dedication vs Consecration
nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: ICKSP Dedication is not the complete Consecration of the Human Race, nor optional Christ the King Benediction rite.

nonconflation.short_name: Full Eucharistic Pange lingua vs Passiontide Pange lingua
nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: Corporis mysterium vs proelium certaminis are different historical hymns; Tantum Ergo is excerpt of the former.
nonconflation.owners: Batch 2 Adoration canonical text; Batch 5 Hymns links; avoid duplicate IDs.

nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: Twenty-Four Glory Bes 9-day Novena, Institute Tuesday Perpetual Novena, 1925 printed Benedict XV-associated prayer, and mission intercession remain distinct.
1883 Moran nine day-specific prayers (historical preparatory 29 Nov–7 Dec) differ from ICKSP Pius X repeat-form (Institute 30 Nov–8 Dec, feast day included).
1909 preconciliar vs 2021 seven-expanded invocation recension must be separate, not silently mixed.
nonconflation.owners: Batch 5 Good Death + St Joseph Prayer Library shared ID.

nonconflation.short_name: Litany of the Saints ritual contexts
nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: Private 1883/1862 witness is not a verified universal 1962 Rogation litany; Easter Vigil and Forty Hours have separate ceremonial conditions.
nonconflation.owners: Batch 3 Litany + Batch 2 Forty Hours + Holy Week proper.

nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: Complete Office of Compline is not an optional five-step Nightly Examen and must not be introduced as undocumented St Pius X 'Short' form.
15 Joyful/Sorrowful/Glorious are traditional Fatima baseline; Luminous set is post-2002 and must be labelled and not imposed on First Saturdays.
nonconflation.owners: Batch 1 Rosary, Batch 2 Rosary Methods, Batch 4 First Saturdays.

nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: August Queen of Heaven is a separate sourced prayer, not extra Angelus line, Regina Caeli variant or original Rosary step.

nonconflation.short_name: Office hymn vs score vs proper
nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: An ICKSP chant score does not create a new lyric identity or confer paid-app redistribution permission; Latin-only recensions must not be passed off as EN/FR.
nonconflation.owners: Batch 5 Hymns, #1800 staged 8/7, Batch 2 Eucharistic hymns.

nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: ICKSP Eternal Priest prayer from separate historical witness is staged English in #1800; second Institute prayer has text-corruption hold, not a verified substitution.

nonconflation.short_name: Private Communion Treasury vs Mass prayers
nonconflation.non_conflation_rule: 7/4 Communion selections feed Mass folios; they are not Postcommunion proper texts and should have one canonical prayer identity.
15-candle public ceremonial witness may coexist with 1960 Matins/Lauds but is not mandatory identical rubrics for all parish services.
Proficiscere is prayer/commendation with source-specific roles, not an app-administered Anointing, Viaticum, absolution or Apostolic Blessing.
nonconflation.owners: Batch 5 Dying Companion, Good Death, Learn Serious Illness.
